hook: Catherine approaches Alexander in tears, declaring her enduring love, only for him to coldly reject her touch and her claims.
cliffhanger: Alexander turns his back on Catherine and walks past her to his true bride, Juliana, leaving Catherine gasping in utter disbelief: 'Her?!'
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the intense emotional betrayal and romantic rejection, though prior context is needed to know why Juliana is in chains.
narrative_context: The dramatic fallout of Alexander's return, where he shatters Catherine's expectations by spurning her affections and turning toward Juliana.
promotional_strength: Features high emotional drama, a sharp rejection, and a satisfying twist where the hero bypasses the presumed love interest for the true heroine.

evidence.observation: Catherine steps away from Rupert and approaches Alexander.
Alexander abruptly pulls back, refusing Catherine's touch.
Catherine gasps in disbelief as Alexander chooses Juliana.

logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Do you know what this did to me?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I mourned you.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I waited for you.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Heartbroken)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I never stopped loving you.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You don't remember?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You were never my Duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: But I loved you!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: No!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I loved you before all this!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Did you?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Her?!
